:::{#exm-norm-euclidean}
#### Euclidean space as a normed vector space

The Euclidean space $\reals^p$ equipped with the Euclidean norm (@def-euclidean-norm)
is a normed vector space:

- Positivity and absolute homogeneity hold by @thm-norm-properties.
- The triangle inequality holds by @thm-triangle-inequality.

Every inner product space $(\reals^p, \iprod{\cdot}{\cdot})$ (@def-inner-product-space)
naturally defines an induced norm $\norm{\vx} \eqdef \sqrt{\iprod{\vx}{\vx}}$,
which satisfies all three norm axioms.

:::
